data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 proposes a dependence on SRC_005 (a leaderless-synchronization mechanism via shared training data) and offers refutation conditions, but it never connects this mechanism to the problem's standard: distinguishing independent vs. merely-uncorrelated failures between decentralized and centralized-redundant services. Algorithmic convergence on shared data is a plausible coupling, but SRC_003 does not say what evidence would show whether failures caused by such convergence are truly independent or only appear so—so the dependence is substantive yet unanchored to the problem's evidentiary demand.
